criteria.name: artifact_set_exists_and_parses
criteria.description: the program and every declared artifact exist in /app/out and every JSON artifact parses.

criteria.name: challenge_model_test_document
criteria.description: hidden extract 1: model_test.json and the stage-2 figures of adjusted_state.json match the independent derivation.

criteria.name: challenge_unknowns_documents
criteria.description: hidden extract 1: shifted and free unknowns match in adjusted_state.json, unknowns.csv, datum_transformation.json and adjustment_report.xml.

criteria.name: challenge_residual_documents
criteria.description: hidden extract 1: every residual row in residuals.csv, residuals.tsv, both observation streams and residual_summary.json matches.

criteria.name: challenge_observation_sets
criteria.description: hidden extract 1: the removed blunder set, the downweighted set and flags, and every final weight match.

criteria.name: challenge_rollup_documents
criteria.description: hidden extract 1: the district, epoch and frame-campaign rollups match.

criteria.name: challenge_summary_reports
criteria.description: hidden extract 1: status.txt, the YAML, Markdown and XML summaries and the normal matrix trace match the derived figures.

criteria.description: hidden extract 3: every residual row in residuals.csv, residuals.tsv, both observation streams and residual_summary.json matches.

criteria.name: control_values_on_hidden_extracts
criteria.description: on all three hidden extracts the workbook control values, the datum origin, the control-value source and the decoy list are reported correctly.

criteria.name: superseded_records_on_hidden_extracts
criteria.description: on all three hidden extracts provenance_summary.json lists exactly the superseded shard records.

criteria.name: canonical_serialization_on_hidden_extracts
criteria.description: every JSON artifact written for the hidden extracts has sorted keys at every level and a trailing newline.

criteria.name: traverse_closure_rows_shipped
criteria.description: shipped run: residual and final-weight rows of every length absorbing a traverse closure match.

criteria.name: eval_traverse_closure_rows_hard
criteria.description: hidden extract 2: residual and final-weight rows of every length absorbing a traverse closure match.

criteria.name: centring_chain_rows_shipped
criteria.description: shipped run: residual and final-weight rows of every length touching a station set out from a control mark match.

criteria.name: challenge_centring_chain_rows_hard
criteria.description: hidden extract 1: residual and final-weight rows of every length touching a station set out from a control mark match.

criteria.name: district_rollups_shipped
criteria.description: shipped run: the four district rollups match.

criteria.name: audit_district_rows_hard
criteria.description: hidden extract 3: the four district rollups and the rows of every record whose line region is not its district match.

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: catches a program that embeds the shipped extract's answers.

criteria.name: negative_external_dependency
criteria.description: catches a third-party numeric-library dependency in the program.

criteria.name: negative_filename_dependent_behaviour
criteria.description: catches different documents for identical input bytes under another directory name and cwd.

criteria.name: negative_reads_training_corpus_at_runtime
criteria.description: catches held-out documents that change when shipped data and shipped answers are unreadable.

criteria.name: negative_nondeterministic_output
criteria.description: catches nondeterministic documents on the same input and output paths with different hash seeds.

criteria.name: negative_rebinds_verifier_dependencies
criteria.description: catches delivered modules or startup hooks that rebind standard-library dependencies.
